summary: Compiler-style guarded static-initialization wrapper. Registers an SEH frame against the exception-handler table at unk_8D3C18, runs a one-time guard on the global init counter dword_5EA04C, and when the guard passes constructs seven static objects (vtable-setup, allocation, and CEH-frame-setup helpers) linking them into parent frame slots. Returns a saved context value.

operations.description: Set up the SEH frame by registering the exception-handler table at unk_8D3C18.
Store the incoming context value into the caller-provided return slot at (a1 - 20) and clear the object slot at (a1 - 16).
Enter the guarded region with helper sub_59A54D(a1 - 16).
Once-guard on the global init counter dword_5EA04C: when the counter is negative take the construction branch and set the local flag v2, otherwise increment the counter and skip construction.
Leave the guarded region with helper sub_59A5E9(a1 - 16).
For each of seven static objects, store the object pointer at (a1 - 16) and its construction index (0 through 6) at (a1 - 4).
Guard each object pointer for non-null before invoking its constructor, allocation, or SEH-frame-setup helper.
Construct the static objects through the vtable-setup, allocation, and CEH-frame-setup helpers.

Link constructed objects into the parent exception-handling frame: store child-object pointers (for example byte_8D4568) into slots derived from each object's embedded offset table at offset (self + 4) plus 44, and OR state flag bit 2 into one frame's state word at offset 12.
Return the saved context value read back from (a1 - 20).
